metric_model: CHAOSS AI Alignment - Community Governed Use

scope.note: Scoring confined to the files named on the command line; 'no' means not addressed in those files.

domains.suggested_improvement: no mention of AI; no supervision level or accountability holder stated
domains.reasoning: CONTRIBUTING.md does not mention AI tools or AI-assisted contributions anywhere. It states the project does not accept pull requests from non-maintainers at all, but this is unrelated to AI policy specifically.

domains.suggested_improvement: no mention of meeting bots or recorded discussion
domains.reasoning: The document does not discuss meetings, recordings, or notetaker bots at all.

domains.suggested_improvement: no rule on AI use for docs/blogs/design assets
domains.reasoning: There is a 'Human language policy' section governing tone and style of user-facing strings and commit messages, but it never mentions AI-generated content or tools.

domains.suggested_improvement: no rule on AI use in moderation actions
domains.reasoning: The 'bad-faith contributions and brigading' section describes enforcement (banning brigaders, rejecting bad-faith issues) but says nothing about AI being used in moderation decisions.
No mention of AI being used to review contributions; the document only says maintainers introduce all changes themselves.

domains.suggested_improvement: no rule on autonomous/agentic AI activity
domains.reasoning: No mention of agents or autonomous AI acting on the repository.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on environmental impact of AI use
domains.reasoning: No text addresses energy, water, or carbon costs of AI tooling.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on server load or hardware cost from AI use
domains.reasoning: No text addresses infrastructure strain from AI tooling.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on project data being used to train models
domains.reasoning: No text addresses whether the project's own content, issues, or discussions may be used to train AI models.

consent_policy_specificity.overall_posture: CONTRIBUTING.md contains no AI-specific policy language whatsoever; it is a general contribution/governance document (no external PRs accepted, issue policy, language style, neutrality, anti-brigading) with zero mention of AI tools, assistants, or agents across any of the nine domains.

awaiting_implementation.specific_tools_in_use: Awaiting implementation: named-product detection beyond known file signatures
awaiting_implementation.ai_tool_owner: Awaiting implementation: ownership and data control
awaiting_implementation.environmental_footprint: Awaiting implementation: model/system card and ESG disclosure
awaiting_implementation.proportionality: Awaiting implementation: resource use relative to contributor count (needs platform usage data)

use_composition_partial.note: Detection only. Absence of signal is not absence of use.

policy_change.blocker: Draft classifier not wired in or validated against hand-graded history. Repo.history() and Repo.commit_patch() supply the diffs.

use_compliance.blocker: Derived metric. Requires disclosed-use data (Use Composition) checked against the specificity grid. Composition is only partially detectable, so the comparison is not yet sound.

misuse.blocker: Not automatable. CHAOSS marks the core signals unknown: text-based AI detectors are unreliable, and license-laundering and wrongful-accusation incidents need maintainer self-report.
